current_boundary: postgres_dialect.go has no regex/string-replacement SQL rewrite. postgresQuery preserves native CREATE/ALTER/DO and otherwise invokes lexical bindPostgres; PostgreSQL-specific repository queries stay explicit.

verified.scope: Local lexical and migration dispatch unit contracts; no native PostgreSQL claim

requirement_map.placeholder_literal_comment_separation: Existing tests cover quoted identifiers, regular/escape strings, nested comments, dollar strings, malformed tokens and bind position bounds.
requirement_map.logical_sqlite_postgres_equivalence: Existing TestRepositoryDialectContracts plus cursor/list corpus, native execution belongs to source-bound CI; this local selection does not establish it.
requirement_map.all_used_query_families_positive_negativ: Not yet proved. Corpus explicitly representative, not a complete production SQL inventory.
requirement_map.unsupported_new_forms: Malformed lexical forms rejected; arbitrary unsupported SQL semantics are not validated by this binder.
requirement_map.injection_claim: No SQL injection vulnerability inferred from semantic coverage gaps.

next: Map production query families to positive/negative executable fixtures and native result-equivalence evidence before RF05 closure.
